title: Research epics: port-validation pipeline + autoresearch
body: Two new research epics registered 2026-06-18: (1) implementation validation pipeline = robust jax-port + audit-fw integration; (2) agentic algorithm evolution & autoresearch with xtrax+bathos. Both require NLM deep/fast research → contemplex brainstorm → spec before implementation. See backlog #2180+#2181 (IDs assigned on add).
